title: Two Fishes
trend: TikTok 'Two Fishes' trend (October 2026, US) — calmly defending a reasonable-unreasonable take to your parents, TED Talk style
youtube_title: Me explaining to my parents why I can keep both fishes 🐟🐟
description:
Theo calmly explains why he can save money and still go to Italy. His parents have a counter-argument. So does the cat.

#twofishes #explainingtomyparents #comedy #animation #shorts
tiktok_caption: me explaining to my parents that i can save money and still travel 🐟🐟 #twofishes #comedy #animation #fyp

lines.text: Mom. Dad. Please sit down. I would like to explain something. Calmly.
Why is there a whiteboard in the living room?
Because this is a presentation, Dad.
Is this about the credit card bill?
It is about fish.
Imagine you have two fishes.
Everybody tells you, you have to put one back.
But who says? Who made that rule?
Nobody said anything about fish, Theo.
The fish are a metaphor, Mom. Stay with me.
He has been practicing this in the mirror since noon.
Fish number one is saving money. Fish number two is going to Italy.
You can't keep both of those fish.
And that, Dad, is exactly what they want you to think.
Who is they?
Them. The fish police.
There is no fish police.
Not with that attitude.
Okay. How exactly do you save money and go to Italy?
Simple. I save money by living here. Rent free.
Then I take the money I saved, and I go to Italy.
So we are paying for Italy.
No. You are investing in Italy. There is a difference.
There is not.
Nobody asked the cat.
The cat also lives here rent free. And the cat does not go to Italy.
She makes a good point.
Fine. Next slide.
I can eat a salad, and also a whole pizza. In the same meal.
That is not two fishes, sweetie. That is one very large fish.
I can be at peace, and completely losing it, at the same time.
That one is true. I have heard him in the shower. Singing and crying.
Son. Life is about choices. You pick a fish. You live with that fish.
Dad. Respectfully. You have two recliners.
That's different.
Why do you need two recliners?
One is for sitting. The other one is for thinking about sitting.
He got you there, Ray.
And Mom. You have two phones.
One is for family. One is for my book club.
The book club does not read books. They eat cake and talk about the neighbors.
Duchess!
So we all keep two fishes. That is my point. Thank you. I will now take questions.
Okay. One question.
Your mom and I also have two fishes.
Great. See? Everybody wins.
Fish number one is our son. Fish number two is turning his bedroom into a home gym.
You can't keep both of those fish.
And that, son, is exactly what they want you to think.
Okay. Who is they?
Us. We are the fish police.
I am also the fish police. Mostly, I just want the fish.
So where am I supposed to sleep?
The gym has a bench.
It is very comfortable. And rent free.
This is a hostile environment.
Fine. New plan. I save money by going to Italy, and just staying there.
That is not how saving works.
Respectfully, nobody in this room is wrong.
He is wrong.
He is wrong.
Not with that attitude.
